📌 The booking rate dropped on both platforms, while Snapchat brought many more leads. The extra Snapchat leads came from the new Eyelid and General Services campaigns, and LASIK bookings on Snapchat were lower than in Oct 1–21.
⚠️ Important: Many Snapchat leads are "No Answer", and most of them are marked "No Answer / Sent by WhatsApp" with no update on what happened next. We need more detailed feedback from the tele-sales team.
📋 We need accurate feedback on the Instagram messages. Some days are not mentioned in the feedback sheet at all, and feedback exists for only part of the messages, so the booking results reflect only part of the picture.
🚨 Leads are often contacted by the tele-sales team only after a few days. This increases the "No Answer" cases and causes lost bookings. The team must take care of this and contact leads as early as possible.

Recommendations

1. We need more case studies and real cases.
How: with the doctors, document real cases as short videos or carousels that show the patient's problem, the procedure and the result.

2. We need more photos and videos for the technologies in the center and the doctors in the clinic.
How: focus on the benefits of each technology for the patient (safer, faster, more accurate) and give patients a live look inside the clinic, such as live tours and behind-the-scenes videos of the devices and the doctors at work, showing the benefits in real use.

3. We need more testimonials and reviews.
How: collect video testimonials from happy patients and film short dialogues between the doctors and patients (with their consent) to use in the ads.
